senses.gloss: m. (dialect. for טַיְיסָן q. v.) proud fool.
units: Ab. Zar. 26ᵃ גרדנא דלא ט׳ שתא בציר מְשַׁנֵּי (Ms. M. … טייזיאן משניה, read: טַיְיזָאן) a year (of) scarce earning will change (better) a weaver, if he be no proud fool. [Var. in Ar. s. v. ג׳ דלטייא׃ גרדנא or דלטייה; Yalk. Gen. 133 … שמתא בצרא …] [The supposed meaning of our w. of humble seems to have risen from a misunderstanding of a running commentary embodied in Rashi a. Tosafoth, where דלא ט׳ is interpreted עניו.]
